annotations.title: Signed record of what Dependency Pulse saw for one service in a window, plus your log hashes

description: A signed record of what Dependency Pulse saw for one service in a time window (up to 7 days back), to keep as evidence for a service-credit claim or a dispute: every reading and state change (the provider's own status words, our timed request results, the rule version), the state carried in, and every gap. Size: about 40 KB for 24 hours (the default) and 220 to 330 KB for 7 days, so ask for the window you need. Optionally send your own failed-call log lines: they are hashed and countersigned as received from you at that time, never as seen by us, and never stored. Does not file a claim, contact a provider or say a credit is owed. Free: 3 records a day per caller; paid records past that are staged on test money, not charging.

from.description: Window start, UTC, like 2026-01-31T13:00:00Z; at most 7 days back. Default: 24 hours before 'to' (never more than 7 days back).

to.description: Window end, UTC, like 2026-01-31T15:00:00Z; not in the future. Default and latest: 2 minutes before now (the newest round may still be saving).

your_log.description: Optional: your own failed-call log lines, one line per item, at most 48,000 bytes as JSON (quotes, backslashes and non-ASCII characters count extra; remove keys and personal data first). Only their sha256 hashes go into the record; the lines are never shown back or stored.
